title: Orchestrate clearance lanes for PRD handshakes across Eng/Design/Legal
creator: Maya Patel
description: Coordinate a lightweight, auditable sign-off flow for PRDs that have conditional rollout or scope-change risk. This ticket defines the clearance lanes (engineering impact, design acceptability, legal/regulatory sign-off), required artifacts, timeline for responses, and fallback triggers for the first 3 pilot PRDs (Private VPC upgrade, Dedicated autoscale policy change, Structured output typed responses). Goal: reduce review cycles and avoid late scope rework by establishing clear owners, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A single PRD review checklist template exists and is linked in the PRD; fields include: security considerations, infra impacts, UI changes, migration plan, rollout gating conditions, and test prompts
Each pilot PRD has named reviewers from Eng, Design, and Legal with explicit SLA to respond in 5 business days or mark a blocking issue
A documented fallback/rollback condition for launch (e.g., disable feature flag, pin model version, revert routing policy) is agreed and included in PRD
Sign-off events are recorded in the PRD with timestamp and reviewer comment; at least one PRD has completed full cross-team sign-off in pilot
Metrics dashboard (link in PRD) is created/updated to show latency, error rate, and cost delta for the feature following rollout
